environment.description: Same Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate with hardened task definition. SecurityContext drops CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. Container runs as non-root (uid 1000). The ECS service is fronted by an internal NLB with a TCP idle timeout of 350s. A Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) is injected via AWS App Mesh with the following configuration: route-level per_try_timeout of 2s, retry_policy with num_retries=1, and a circuit_breaker with max_pending_requests=50 and max_requests=100. The Envoy outlier detection is configured with consecutive_gateway_failure=3 and enforcing_consecutive_gateway_failure=100. Additionally, the JVM is started with -XX:+UseContainerSupport and the application.properties sets spring.mvc.async.request-timeout=3000 and server.tomcat.connection-timeout=5000.
